items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: he had a little baby and the little baby, Joe, was breaking things

ctx.x: John Bartee, and he made that because when he was trying to arrange, in his house, he had a little baby and the little baby, Joe, was breaking things, making noise, crying, and he was very gentle, he is a very gentle, he used to say: "Please, please, please, don't make no noise"; so from that particular atmosphere or whatever, he wrote that number, "No Noise".
Oh! the phrase "No Noise" he got it while he was telling his child - children - not to make any noise?
